source.summary: Daria is the sole BA across four projects at a 60-person digital agency, spending ~12 hours a week arranging artifacts in Miro, Slides and Notion. Her sharpest pains are quotes detaching from their source, retyping between tools, and reconstructing reasoning at handoff; she wants one linked place and an AI first-draft she can see the receipts for.

nuggets.text: She is the only BA on three of four concurrent projects, which is one too many.
nuggets.quote: Right now I'm on four projects at the same time, which is, honestly, one too many.

nuggets.text: She spends about twelve hours a week just arranging artifacts in Miro, Slides and Notion for clients.
nuggets.quote: Maybe twelve hours a week in Miro and Slides and Notion just arranging things so a client can look at them.

nuggets.text: She copies interview notes out of Notion by hand into Miro stickies and clusters them manually.
nuggets.quote: I copy the notes out of Notion by hand, paste them as stickies, cluster them.

nuggets.text: Clustering six interviews by hand takes her a full day.
nuggets.quote: That clustering takes me, I don't know, a full day for six interviews.

nuggets.text: Once a quote is on a slide she cannot find which interview it came from.
nuggets.quote: Because I know somebody said it, I just can't find which interview.

nuggets.text: She once attributed a quote to the wrong segment and the client caught it in the room.
nuggets.quote: Once I attributed a quote to the wrong person's segment and the client caught it in the room.

nuggets.text: She reuses a two-year-old Miro swim-lane template for every journey map.
nuggets.quote: Journey maps are Miro again, I have a template I've been reusing for two years.

nuggets.text: She retypes each Miro pain point into a Jira epic and then nobody in Jira knows where it came from.
nuggets.quote: A pain point in Miro becomes an epic in Jira, and I retype it. And then in Jira nobody knows where it came from.

nuggets.text: At the agency personas are a deliverable, not a living thing, because no one is paid to maintain them.
nuggets.quote: They're a deliverable, not a living thing.

nuggets.text: She keeps an assumptions table in Notion for only two of four projects; the rest live in her head.
nuggets.quote: For two of the four projects it exists. For the others it's in my head, which I know is bad.

nuggets.text: Her hypotheses link to a Notion interview page but never to the exact moment.
nuggets.quote: A Notion link to the interview page. But not to the exact moment.

nuggets.text: After a client ignored an evidence spreadsheet she built, she now only sources claims when someone pushes.
nuggets.quote: So now I only do it when somebody pushes.

nuggets.text: For prioritization she runs a value-versus-effort two-by-two in Miro rather than RICE.
nuggets.quote: I'm in a prioritization workshop where we use, like, a two-by-two in Miro. Value versus effort. Not RICE

nuggets.text: RICE scores get argued rather than calculated, so the scoring is just theater with numbers.
nuggets.quote: the tool does nothing, it's just theater with numbers.

nuggets.text: When she drops an interview, she wants a highlighted line to become a persona quote, a journey pain point and the source for the epic, all keeping their link.
nuggets.quote: Where I drop the interview, it gets transcribed, I highlight a line, and that line can become a quote on the persona, a pain point on the journey, and the source for the epic.

nuggets.text: She wants the tool to auto-cluster her notes and propose a first-draft persona.
nuggets.quote: auto-cluster my notes, propose a first-draft persona.

nuggets.text: She will accept an AI draft she can see the receipts for, but not a black box.
nuggets.quote: A draft I can see the receipts for, yes. A black box, no.

nuggets.text: She would expense twenty-five dollars a month without asking, and need director approval at thirty-five.
nuggets.quote: if I could expense it, I'd say twenty-five a month and I wouldn't ask anyone. Thirty-five, I'd have to ask my director

nuggets.text: She trialed Dovetail and loved the tagging, but it was another island that connected to nothing.
nuggets.quote: I loved the tagging, but it didn't connect to anything, it was another island.

nuggets.text: She would not want to lose the collaborative whiteboard part of Miro for workshops.
nuggets.quote: I wouldn't want to lose the collaborative whiteboard part.

nuggets.text: At handoff she has to reconstruct the reasoning for a requirement from about three tools.
nuggets.quote: I have to reconstruct the reasoning from, like, three tools.

nuggets.text: Her core job is to make the client confident they are building the right thing.
nuggets.quote: make the client confident that we're building the right thing.

nuggets.text: She wants persona and journey views that are readable on a phone, since clients review on mobile.
nuggets.quote: If the persona or journey view was readable on a phone, that alone would be a win.

nuggets.text: She wants to share with a client via a public link without making them create an account.
nuggets.quote: sharing with a client without giving them an account. A public link.

nuggets.text: She would worry about a generated persona only if it had no grounding she could click through.
nuggets.quote: I'd worry if it had no grounding.
